integrity: The 2026 primary full text was inspected at the weighted Radau definition, the differentiation identity, the discrete corollary, the small-phase sharpness proposition, the explicit remark leaving the discrete range unresolved, and the Lebesgue-function consequences. The degree-two and degree-three extrema were reconstructed exactly from Jacobi formulas. Strict monotonicity of the amplitude ratio was proved analytically on the full beta>-1 interval; the displayed decimal threshold is only a numerical evaluation of the exact unique root.
scientific_limitations: The result completely classifies only the first nontrivial weighted Jacobi--Radau discrete comparison, m=2 and k=1. It does not determine the optimal common parameter range over all degrees, and it makes no global Lebesgue-constant claim below beta=-1/3. The sharp threshold is defined by an explicit transcendental equation rather than an algebraic closed form.
title: Exact first discrete threshold below the Jacobi–Radau continuous barrier
